agent_notes: The exact institution is established in the NIRF 2025 Overall government listing with city Gwalior and state Madhya Pradesh; the official site header and contact page identify the same Gwalior LNIPE campus.
The official homepage, central courses page, dedicated programme pages and Ph.D. page were fetched directly from www.lnipe.edu.in using CLI HTTPS requests only.

The managed proxy produced the exact self-signed-certificate-in-chain TLS error on the first normal request. After confirming the expected official hostnames, public GET requests used curl --insecure; no credentials or private data were sent.

Manual review is required because the official 2026 admission page dated 04-07-2026 carries a discontinuation notice for MA (Sports Journalism), MA (YOGA) and PGDFM, while the central All Courses page and dedicated pages still list those entries.

The official 2026 admission page also exposes Diploma in Naturopathy in application, entrance and result notices, but the programme is absent from the central All Courses page and has no dedicated catalogue page; it is included only as verified_programme_family with null duration and eligibility.
The official Ph.D. page separately lists Physical Education, Yoga and Inter-Disciplinary programmes; the central All Courses page does not include doctoral entries.

Short-term/news-only items such as the six-week certificate course in Sports Coaching, Certificate course in Yoga/Naturopathy/Message Therapy, Summer Camp and similar extension activities were excluded; they are not active formal catalogue programmes for this record.
M.A. Yoga and M.A. Sports Journalism pages contain incomplete generic/empty programme metadata, so their current active status and full admission details are not guessed.
Career mappings were read from career_path.db in SQLite read-only mode; no database edits were made.
